9.5/10 game. I know I'm a bit late to review, and people probably won't see this, but here goes.
    A long time ago I played a game called Rune Factory frontier for the Wii, which was a very fun game. However, there were a lot of things about the game that I didn't like...Then, this game came out--and I heard a rumor that the developer was inspired by the harvest moon games. (The same people who made the rune factory games), and I knew I had to try it out. Fast forward to now, I've playing this game for years on the PC and even on the mobile version as well.
    What I loved was that Stardew Valley took a lot of what I liked about the rune factory games and made it... better. Even some of the issues from those games, Stardew somehow got rid of them with it's own unique story and game mechanics, and it really drew me in.
    As many of the people on here have said, there have definitely been some dark times in my life, where games like these was my only escape. I even played this game for a long time with my ex, and even though we split, I still see fond memories of her whenever I see this game in my library. Though, I'm still a bit hesitant to pick it up again whenever I see it, but I know one day I will return to my Stardew Valley--and everyone, the villagers, will be waiting for me! Who knows, I might return with friends as well :)

I 100% the game, so lets write a review! :D

How can you not love Stardew Valley? Lovely characters, charming lore, fun mechanics, every single update brings you back again and again! I'd say for sure, with complete certainty, that this is THE farming game of all time. Of course, it's more then just a farming game, but you get what I mean! I'm not one for this type of pixel graphics, but even that is done just perfectly! You can tell this game has love weaved between every line of code. Wonderful, wonderful, wonderful! 

Absolutely something to come back to again and again and again, explore every story, pick apart every secret drop of information, decorate your farm, dig through every update, check out the modding scene! Absolutely something I'd recommend any day!
I love this game and everything about it. It's pretty much the perfect video game as far as I am concerned. Absolute Peak. 10/10. The Best.

Stardew Valley representa el refinamiento del género de granjas. Incluso si no te gustan los juegos de ese estilo, podrías jugar este y engancharte completamente por su kinestesia. No te obliga a hacer nada a menos que quieras y aún así te sientes como si el viaje fuera completamente necesario, al tiempo que te presenta desafíos para seguir adelante y progresar sin sentirse molesto. Aunque es un juego sobre granjas, los personajes no se sienten medio-cocidos, ni sienten que estan hechos para ocupar roles y ya esta. Tienen su propio encanto, Y el juego no le da ese tipo de seriedad condescendiente que pudieses esperar de algún juego narrativo, ya que el juego reconoce que es solamente un juego de granjas. 

No voy a seguir tratando de hacerme el interesante. Llevo más de 122 horas jugadas en Steam y cientos de horas jugadas en negro. Si no has gastado, gástalo ya. ...dale todo tu dinero a Eric Barone.

Absolutely LOVE this game!

(EDIT: i've realized i said mostly negative things about this game while saying i recommend it, lolz. it truly is one of my favorite games, as although i hate it sometimes, just because i hate it doesn't mean it isn't one of my favorites. what's a favorited game without rage-inducing scripture?)

what a game. i recommend it, although i've been playing "Fields of Mistria," recently, i cant say i'll ever abandon stardew valley, even though its FAR from cozy, id say its a bit more stress-inducing. if you don't like slightly repetitive games with lots-of-things-to-do-at-once quests, this isn't for you. its also not very beginner friendly, at all. but it doesn't mean it wont hurt to take some time to learn the basics. 

i've always loved farm-sim type games, and although it came out over ten years ago i only bought it recently on a spur of the moment. i don't play it on a continuous basis, i often play it every couple of months when i either remember i have it downloaded, or see a video about it. even then, i'll play for around two weeks. it definitely doesn't hold your attention for a long time, like minecraft.

i've only had a few complaints about it here and there, especially with how REPETITIVE it gets at a certain point in time. there's nothing new to me in this game anymore. its boring, maybe its just a me thing, but every new save i make, i spend the first year doing the same exact thing i do in every other save. farm, mine, waste money on things that don't have any value to me in the first year, and repeat. day-time is too short, forces you to speed-run things on a daily basis, whether its petting animals/pets, running to the blacksmith or robins, and even trying to talk to every NPC to up that relationship bar, i despise how it depletes over a course of time. the NPCs feel lifeless at a certain point. repetitive dialogue, lifeless, dead, garbage raccoons that just wander around or stand in the same spot for hours on end. its just a bit stereotypical. there needs to be new characters with more depth. these are unemotional pixels with no character. thank HEAVENS for mods that add new characters, new towns, etc., they are my holy grail when it comes to feeling something new in this game. also disappointed with the character customization. 

you'll either love it or hate it, buy it, or don't buy it. no ones forcing you to play or buy a game you know you won't enjoy. if you just leave a half-assed review with twenty minutes in the damn game, saying its just "boring," with a singular word, or just saying its horribly written with no other context but your false criticism, why'd you even BOTHER downloading it if you wont give it a chance?
